pages.text: Generators make power only while they run, and reactors make far more than a base uses at once. Energy storage keeps the surplus for later: charge it while the reactor runs at full power, then draw from it at night, while a turbine spins up or when a
whole drone fleet comes home to charge.$(br2)CyberFarm has two kinds of storage: a small one to start with and a big one you build up over time.

pages.title: Battery Bank: the small one
pages.text: The $(l:energy_storage/battery_bank)Battery Bank$(/l) is a block that stores $(l)150,000 FE$(). Blocks placed together join into one bank of up to $(l)3x3x3$(), which stores 4,050,000 FE. It is enough for a small base, and it can feed a $(l:trinkets/human_dock)Human Dock$(/l) directly.

CyberFarm's big battery is a structure you $(l)build bigger$(), tier by tier. It has three parts:$(br)$(li)$(l:energy_storage/resonance_core)Resonance Core$(/l): the pedestal with the floating crystal. It is the battery itself and has the screen.
pages.title: Resonance Core: the big one

pages.text: $(li)$(l:energy_storage/resonance_cell)Resonance Cell$(/l): the blocks of the shell around the crystal. A bigger shell is a higher tier that stores more.

$(li)$(l:energy_storage/stabilizer_pylon)Stabilizer Pylon$(/l): columns of pylons that hold the crystal steady. They are its $(l)only way in and out$() for power, so it works with $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l) and with any other mod's cables.$(br)$(li)$(l:energy_storage/resonance_core)Resonance Core$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:energy_storage/resonance_cell)Resonance Cell$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:energy_storage/stabilizer_pylon)Stabilizer Pylon$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l)1$(): none, 1,000,000 FE, 1, 16,000 FE/t
